Chapter 6460: Must I Beg?

Chapter 6460: Must I Beg?

“Luosha Devil Emperor!” Spectators felt like ants gazing at a true dragon.

Evilsurge felt like a dog that had just lost its master. Today was not his day but there was nowhere to run.

A palm strike struck him and sent him to another pit; his blood stained the soil.

“It’s too late, Evilsurge.” The attacker spoke, possessing an oceanic level of golden power.

“Ocean-gaze Ancestor!” Another big shot terrified the crowd.

Evilsurge, a great apex emperor, became a prisoner in no time.

“Welcome, Young Noble.” Luosha and Ocean-gaze respectfully bowed.

Everyone turned into statues, not daring to breathe loudly. They stay on the ground despite not feeling any pressure.

Luosha Devil Emperor and Ocean-gaze Ancestor were two supreme lords, capable of determining the direction of Gold Village.

Normally, just seeing them alone was the greatest fortune. Now, both kneeled before this unknown man.

Dugu Qing had had cold sweat since she knew more than the rest. Her progenitor, Dugu Yuan, was only one step away from becoming a supreme overlord.

They believed he was the strongest in Old World. However, these two wouldn’t kneel before him. Did this mean the youth was someone even greater? A supreme overlord in Old World?

Li Qiye raised his hand, gesturing for them to rise.

“What do you want?” Evilsurge asked, unable to move an inch.

“The young noble will decide your punishment.” Goldblade smiled.

“Do as you wish but you won’t make a fool out of me.” Evilsurged uttered coldly; his back was as straight as could be.

“Are you not afraid of death?” Li Qiye smiled.

“An emperor does not fear death.” Evilsurge said.

“Courageous.” Li Qiye praised.

“Emperors of Trinity have never asked for mercy.” Evilsurge said.

“Haha, well said.” Li Qiye nodded.

“Who dares attack an emperor of Trinity?!” Suddenly, a spear pierced through the sky and landed at Octagon.

This cultivator cared not about the crowd and let his aura roam freely, capable of reducing experts such as Dugu Qing to blood.

“Who is it?!” The crowd shouted.

“It’s Iron-spear Ancestor!” A keen-eyed cultivator spotted the spear.

“Traitor.” Iron-spear’s expression darkened upon spotting Luosha.

However, when he saw Li Qiye, he looked struck by lightning and stumbled backward.

“Being lucky once isn’t enough?” Li Qiye said.

Iron-spear turned pale, not expecting to meet Li Qiye who nearly killed him with a cooking pot last time.

He forgot about dignity and turned to flee.

“Capture him.” Li Qiye ordered.

Ocean-gaze and Luosha immediately gave chase, shocking the crowd with their obedience. Some thought about how they had offended Li Qiye before and fainted.

“Looks like Trinity can’t save you.” Li Qiye said.

“I am not afraid.” Evilsurge said.

“Very well.” Li Qiye smiled and said: “Release him.”

Evilsurge and everyone else couldn’t believe it. He himself was ready to die.

“Be more careful next time.” Goldblade laughed.

Evilsurge stood there in silence, not knowing what to do.

“Must I beg before you leave?” Li Qiye joked.

He took a deep breath and said: “If you won’t kill me, then let me look at the golden spring.”

“Bold.” Li Qiye smiled in response.

“Buzz.” Strands of light came from the room behind Li Qiye again, causing everyone else to resonate brightly.
